sloka: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारा सर्वाङ्गशोभना ।आहूय चाब्रवीत् सर्वा वानराणां तु योषितः ।। ६.१२६.२९ ।।
transliteration: sugrīvasya vacaḥ śrutvā tārā sarvāṅgaśobhanā ।āhūya cābravīt sarvā vānarāṇāṁ tu yoṣitaḥ ।। 6.126.29 ।।

translations.english: Vaidehi having spoken like that, Raghava replied her saying 'So be it' and Raghava stopped Pushpaka at Kishkinda, looked at Sugriva and spoke as follows.
